title: Grade 10 MUSIC AND DANCE — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

3. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.
   B. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.

4. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   C. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.

5. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.

7. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.
   C. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Transposition.
   C. Damage equipment used for Transposition.
   D. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   B. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Western Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Appreciation 3.1 Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dance from Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

2. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Red, blue, and yellow

10. D — The speed of the music

11. D — Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Musical Instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Appreciation 3.1 Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 C; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary Dance from Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
